name: Savage Offensive — kicked adds +1/+1 to creatures you control
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py ('otherwise' / 'if kicked … instead' theme). 'Creatures you control gain first strike until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, they get +1/+1 until end of turn.' No 'instead': first strike always applies and the kicked sentence adds to it, with 'they' resolved to 'Creatures you control'.
